BrochureContent.Content:
DNG are excited to present “St John's” No. 4 Vevay Road to the market. This exceptional family home is sure to impress with its bright, modern interior, superb location and extended accommodation of approximately 99 Sq M. Boasting a well maintained and upgraded interior, this property is presented in “walk in” condition throughout. Outside off street parking is provided for and a lovely courtyard garden further enhances the character of this 3 bedroom semi detached home.

The bright and spacious accommodation comprises entrance hall with modern shower room off, large living room that is set into two spaces, one living room and one playroom, there is a small home office off the playroom to the front. Through sliding doors to the modern and bright kitchen with velux window to flood the room with natural light, there is sliding doors to the rear garden and a spacious storage room to the rear. 

The front garden provides off street parking for two cars and a gated side entrance leads to a well maintained courtyard garden of approx. 5.8m x 4.7m in size. The garden completely remodelled in 2012 features an artificial lawn and patio area bordered by well stocked, raised flower beds. This is an ideal low maintenance entertainment space for all the family to enjoy all year round.

The location is second to none being so close to the Main Street and only minutes' walk away from all the amenities that the town has to offer. Several primary and secondary schools, shops and restaurants are only a stone throw away, public transport is very convenient to the property with Dublin Bus, Bus Eireann and Aircoach bus services all operating within 100 meters. The Dart station is also easily accessible. 

Viewing is a must to appreciate what this lovely home and excellent location have to offer.

Extended 3 bedroom semi detached family home 
Accommodation of approximately 99 Sq M Superb location on the Vevay Road in the heart of Bray Town Centre 
Off street parking for 2 cars 
Modern kitchen with velux windows 
Two living spaces, one living and one playroom
Separate home office 
Three well proportioned bedrooms
Built in wardrobes in two of the bedrooms 
Gas fired central heating 
Private rear garden
Walking distance of all the amenities that Bray Town has to offer 
Security alarm system
